rows.basis: The September 2024 earnings release and the FY2024 MD&A both say Microsoft will buy the output of the restarted Crane plant (former TMI Unit 1) to help power its PJM data centers. This is contracted power to a data-center customer, not AI revenue, and no dollar amount or share is stated; deliveries begin only with the restart, targeted for 2027.
